title: Embo, which is developing world models for robotics trained on massive amounts of internet video, emerges from stealth with a $110M seed led by a16z (Embo)
summary: Embo: Embo, which is developing world models for robotics trained on massive amounts of internet video, emerges from stealth with a $110M seed led by a16z — Embo is building the next generation of frontier AI models, with a deep understanding of physical reality and fine-grained motor skills.
